title: خوش‌آمد
observed_current: وب: AuthFlowScreen درون مودال با SPLASH؛ native: onboarding WELCOME. هر دو پیام برند/راهنما دارند.
entry_exit: ورود سرد به onboarding/auth؛ بعد از شروع به جایابی/گیت می‌رود. کاربر بازگشتی باید مستقیم S07 باشد.
required_states: first-run، returning، reduce-motion، loading brand، network-independent welcome
child_parent_gates: هیچ داده کودک پیش از adult consent ذخیره نشود؛ خروج در وب از مودال مجاز است، native back در گام اول از اپ خارج می‌شود.
accessibility_rtl: RTL روی html و native force شده است. CTA باید حداقل ۵۶dp، focus واضح، متن ۲۰px کودک؛ animation با reduce-motion خاموش.

issues.finding: Start باید S02 باشد ولی native مستقیماً Q1 placement را باز می‌کند (P1؛ apps/mobile/app/onboarding.tsx:13-19,86-104). وب SPLASH زمان‌دار ۲٫۲ ثانیه است و CTA ندارد (P2؛ apps/web/components/AuthFlowScreen.tsx:54-63,155-182).

proposed_corrected_flow: Welcome → Start → S02 auth (وب) یا مسیر واحد onboarding قراردادی؛ returning → S07؛ حالت کم‌حرکت بدون انیمیشن و با CTA فوری.
mobile_parity: وب و native هر دو وجود دارند اما جریان یکسان نیست؛ mobile missing S02 auth and uses placement before consent.

title: ورود خانواده
observed_current: وب AuthFlow gateway شماره، Google و guest دارد؛ phone is only local state. Native route/component معادل ندارد.
entry_exit: S01 start → auth; OTP→S03؛ Google موفق→S04 طبق قرارداد، اما فعلاً setup را باز می‌کند.
required_states: offline، invalid phone، provider/SDK failure، loading، guest policy، consent/privacy
child_parent_gates: ParentGate قبل از data collection در وب؛ guest باید adult consent و محدودیت واضح داشته باشد؛ خرید/حساب parent-only.
accessibility_rtl: phone و کد LTR با برچسب؛ خطای inline و قابل screen-reader؛ دکمه‌های وب فعلی aria-label ندارند و برخی ۳۲px‌اند.

issues.finding: Google/OTP هیچ provider/API ندارند و guest fake completion است (apps/web/components/AuthFlowScreen.tsx:110-131,259-309).
قرارداد S02→S03/S04 نیست؛ Google/guest مستقیم learner setup می‌روند (همان:123-135).
شماره حداقل length است نه country-code validation (همان:353-370).

proposed_corrected_flow: S01→S02؛ احراز adult واقعی و privacy consent؛ mobile OTP با country selector → S03؛ provider success→S04؛ خطا state حفظ input و retry.
mobile_parity: Missing mobile parity: native onboarding has no phone/Google auth or S02 route; stores profile locally after gate (apps/mobile/app/onboarding.tsx:53-60).

title: کد ورود
observed_current: وب OTP local: input maxLength=6, timer 60; verify accepts >=4 and directly setup. No actual delivery/resend handler.
entry_exit: S02 submit code → S03; edit phone/back; success→S04 or returning S07.
required_states: wrong/expired، rate-limit، delivery failure، resend countdown، offline، keyboard LTR
child_parent_gates: adult auth state; never expose full phone.
accessibility_rtl: OTP input dir=ltr، one-time-code semantics، focus and error announcement.

issues.finding: no server verification or expiry/rate-limit (apps/web/components/AuthFlowScreen.tsx:110-121,323-400).
six-digit spec conflicts with `otpCode.length < 4` (همان:117-120,375-389).
resend label is not an active resend; only resets to phone screen (همان:391-398).

proposed_corrected_flow: Mask number; exactly six numeric digits; verify server; failure-specific copy; resend disabled until timer zero; success route by existing profile.
mobile_parity: Missing native S03 entirely.

title: انتخاب پایه
observed_current: وب grade grid in AuthFlow; GRADES map includes active/inactive and user can change top-bar grade later. Native hardcodes G1 at save.
entry_exit: S03 success → grade; first choice→S05; existing profile→S07; future grade only explain, not start.
required_states: initial، switching، existing progress، unavailable content، loading/error manifest
child_parent_gates: adult gate already passed; changing grade must warn about preserving progress and cannot expose unpublished route.
accessibility_rtl: RTL grid buttons have aria-pressed; add group label, selected state not color-only, focus order right-to-left.

issues.finding: native does not implement six-grade selection; `gradeId: G1` hardcoded (apps/mobile/app/onboarding.tsx:53-60).
web grade step is inside auth modal, not `/grade`; no deep-link/back route (apps/web/components/AuthFlowScreen.tsx:185-225).
web inactive grades disabled but no detail/release announcement beyond generic text.

proposed_corrected_flow: Load availability from manifest; select G1→S05; select future grade→explain coming soon; existing child→S07 with confirmation only if changing grade.
mobile_parity: Partial native: only G1, no grade UI.

title: پروفایل کودک
observed_current: وب learner setup has name input only and defaults آرش; native asks name only. No ChildAvatar renderer in onboarding.
entry_exit: S04 → profile; existing profile bypasses; save→S06.
required_states: name list/alias validation، save failure، existing profile، offline local save
child_parent_gates: adult consent before any child data; alias only, no real name/age; input max length and no sensitive fields.
accessibility_rtl: Native input has accessibilityLabel and maxLength 20; web label is visual only. Avatar required in design but absent both.

issues.finding: missing initial avatar selection and unified ChildAvatar renderer (web apps/web/components/AuthFlowScreen.tsx:406-435; native apps/mobile/app/onboarding.tsx:137-145).
web default `آرش` can become real identity without explicit alias guidance (web:39,415-423).
save is localStorage callback, not durable account profile (web apps/web/app/page.tsx:80-89).

proposed_corrected_flow: adult pass→alias + generated avatar preview→save transaction; on failure retain fields and retry; continue→S06; existing child→S07.
mobile_parity: Partial; native name/save exists, avatar absent.

title: جایابی
observed_current: وب/native implement only two diagnostic questions (count/pattern); no explicit skip. Native placement is before parent gate, contrary docs.
entry_exit: S05→intro/questions; finish or skip→S07; returning must not repeat.
required_states: intro، stop، helped، no evidence، suggested start، offline save
child_parent_gates: No guide in independent assessment; parent gate before profile/data; label result as suggestion, not score.
accessibility_rtl: Native buttons have roles; no live region for progress; ensure no mascot cue during question and announce question index.

issues.finding: only two items and no skip action in both implementations (web apps/web/components/PlacementFlow.tsx:20-35,109-165; native apps/mobile/app/onboarding.tsx:99-124).
native asks placement before parent consent (apps/mobile/app/onboarding.tsx:13-19,99-134).
web all-correct seeds four completed nodes locally (apps/web/app/page.tsx:303-318), not server placement outcome.

proposed_corrected_flow: S05→consent→intro→optional skip or 2+ evidence items→suggested start; persist only after adult-approved profile; no reward/mastery from placement.
mobile_parity: Native exists but order and skip differ; web has local fast-track.

title: مسیر
observed_current: Web main shell renders Duolingo-like zigzag path with 8 nodes and 3 tabs PATH/BACKPACK/PROFILE; native renders 5 stations and same 3 tabs. Node click opens lesson directly.
entry_exit: S06→path; node→S09; unit title should→S08; returning profile→path.
required_states: offline ready، not downloaded، prereq lock، completion، sync pending
child_parent_gates: No parent gate for child path; adult access via gated menu; locked node must expose prerequisite relationship and not just tooltip.
accessibility_rtl: RTL DOM/read order; path must be keyboard navigable, not rely on fixed SVG coordinates; web node buttons have no aria labels. Current native has accessibility labels.

issues.finding: five-tab contract is not implemented; web/native expose only three tabs (web apps/web/components/ChildBottomNav.tsx:7-18; native apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:8-35).
web fixed SVG coordinates may misalign with responsive path (web apps/web/components/DuolingoPath.tsx:266-294).
sync indicator is hardcoded green and periodic sync failure only console.warn (web apps/web/components/ChildTopBar.tsx:209-220; apps/web/app/page.tsx:110-146).
no visible download/not-downloaded state.

proposed_corrected_flow: Recommend 4 primary child tabs: مسیر, تمرین, کمد/گنجینه, پروفایل. Keep skills as section of تمرین, not fifth tab. Path header→unit list S08; active node→S09; lock card names prerequisite; pending sync badge truthful.
mobile_parity: Native parity partial: path and 3 tabs exist; practice/wardrobe and required offline states missing.

title: واحد
observed_current: No web/native unit-detail route/component; path header visually contains unit concept but node tap bypasses unit.
required_states: locked، completed، manifest download، manifest error
child_parent_gates: Child can see unlocked content; skip/jump requires evidence and no adult gate unless paid content.
accessibility_rtl: Heading hierarchy and four node labels; preserve focus on return; status not color-only.

issues.finding: screen and route are absent; `handleNodeSelect` opens lesson modal directly (apps/web/app/page.tsx:172-177) and native home routes station directly (apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:50-57).
no manifest/error/download UI in either route.

proposed_corrected_flow: Path unit card→title/objective/audio→4 nodes with status→start/continue; manifest fetch skeleton/error; jump action→S13.
mobile_parity: Missing native parity.

title: شروع ایستگاه
observed_current: Web has no start screen; node opens DuolingoLessonModal. Native station auto-starts immediately, with ENTRY preparing/retry state.
required_states: replay، incomplete package، saved session، loading/error
child_parent_gates: No parent gate; preserve checkpoint on back.
accessibility_rtl: Close button 44px web/native, but native has exit confirmation and web closes immediately; announce loading state.

issues.finding: missing dedicated concept/time/audio start screen; direct modal bypasses S09 (web apps/web/app/page.tsx:172-177).
native auto-start explicitly says no extra start screen (apps/mobile/src/station/StationFlow.tsx:316-323), contrary template.
web backend init failure silently falls back (web apps/web/components/DuolingoLessonModal.tsx:78-101).

proposed_corrected_flow: S09 shows concept, scene, duration, replay/resume, package status, audio play; CTA starts S10; exit returns path; saved session resume is explicit.
mobile_parity: Native has ENTRY loading/retry and resume logic but not S09 visual; web missing.

title: درس
observed_current: Web modal supports several exercise types, local fallback, correctness drawer; native StationFlow has LEARN/GUIDED etc and remote/local runtime.
required_states: correct، staged help، wrong, drag/tap, resume، audio fallback، submit/loading
child_parent_gates: Approved encounter metadata chooses speaker; assessment suppresses mascot; child-safe no punitive score.
accessibility_rtl: Web close aria-label and 44px; native progressbar/roles. Web interactive scene uses emoji/buttons, no explicit audio/hint state.

issues.finding: web completion can be granted twice: server station pass then `handleContinue` calls onCompleteNode again (web apps/web/components/DuolingoLessonModal.tsx:148-157,201-209).
no actual audio/hint control despite template (web:348-374,919-939).
web fallback local correctness when backend fails risks presenting mastery as verified (web:169-195).
desktop fixed modal absolute, no focus trap/aria dialog.

proposed_corrected_flow: S10 server-authoritative encounter; one guide from approved metadata; hint ladder and audio fallback; loading disables submit; offline answer queued and marked pending; exit confirmation saves checkpoint; independent check no companion.
mobile_parity: Native substantially richer state machine and checkpoint (apps/mobile/src/station/StationFlow.tsx:330-369,421-430), but no explicit audio and no web parity.

title: بازی پایانی
observed_current: Web treats all node types as one lesson modal and no 3-round story/difficulty model. Native has GAME_PATTERN/GAME_COUNT transitions and local content but UI is generic.
required_states: guide-needed، rest، saved continuation، fresh variant، no forced timer
child_parent_gates: No punitive timer; game rewards separate from mastery; Jiko contextual speaker.
accessibility_rtl: Progress and rounds announced; avoid emoji-only meaning; touch targets ≥56dp.

issues.finding: web has no separate 3-round/difficulty game state (web apps/web/components/DuolingoLessonModal.tsx:29-41,324-375).
native game stages exist but transition is content-id-specific and not a distinct product route (apps/mobile/src/station/StationFlow.tsx:132-161,421-430).
no round count/time disclosure.

proposed_corrected_flow: S11 story intro→3 optional-paced rounds→rest/retry→finish; Jiko only; variant selected by skill/difficulty; no countdown; result to S12.
mobile_parity: Partial native stages; web missing separate game contract.

title: نتیجه
observed_current: Web FINISHED panel has stars, 100% mastery and continue/repeat; native RESULT then COMPLETE, server pass, repeat/home.
required_states: helped vs independent، duplicate reward، pending verification، retry
child_parent_gates: Mastery/result must come from runtime; pending never shown as certain; rewards non-duplicating.
accessibility_rtl: Web result has strong visual but no live region; native buttons roles; use semantic text for stars.

issues.finding: web result hardcodes +3 and 100% and invokes completion locally (web apps/web/components/DuolingoLessonModal.tsx:780-825).
web no separate helped/independent distinction in copy.
native syncPending returns message without result transition (apps/mobile/src/station/StationFlow.tsx:125-128,189-193), needs explicit pending state.

proposed_corrected_flow: Show evidence-based learning summary, independent/helped label, reward only on verified pass, pending banner, replay S09, continue path.
mobile_parity: Native has result/complete and syncPending but reward/accessory parity absent.

title: پرش

child_parent_gates: Independent assessment: no guide; no mastery unlock until authoritative verification.
accessibility_rtl: Explain prerequisite in text; question navigation and result announcement; no color-only lock.

issues.finding: no S13 implementation; web locked click only sets 2s notice (web apps/web/components/DuolingoPath.tsx:165-171,351-370); native disables locked Pressable (apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:63-73).

proposed_corrected_flow: Explain jump and skill prerequisite→multi-format check→temporary/offline result→server decision→unlock or return path; no purchase CTA.
mobile_parity: Missing native and web parity.

3-tab nav omits games (web ChildBottomNav.tsx:7-18; native tabs layout:8-35).

accessibility_rtl: Web skill cards are divs, not buttons, so no S16 navigation; native cards also noninteractive.

mobile_parity: Partial mobile card exists; lacks interactions, 5 families, review states.

mobile_parity: Missing native parity.

no empty state target.

accessibility_rtl: Preview alt/label, selected state, focus; unsaved/apply confirmation.
